rules.description: Malicious litellm releases on PyPI. 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 (March 2026) and 1.107.0 (uploaded 2026-10-21, 11:39 to 11:40 UTC) carry a .pth file that runs a credential stealer at every Python start, without litellm being imported; 1.107.0 adds a sitecustomize.py that fetches and runs remote code every hour. The upstream git tags do not contain the payload. Versions from the OSV record's affected data; 1.106.2 and 1.107.0rc1/rc2 are not affected.
